T3.attack_vector: Upload malicious firmware through the unauthenticated BLE OTA channel

T1.attack_vector: Exploitation of STRIDE-S-001 (Spoofing Identity via BLE Device Impersonation) via replay targeting Unlock Command

T2.attack_vector: Compromise of a JWT bearer token via credential stuffing on the cloud HTTPS REST API, allowing the attacker to impersonate a legitimate user and obtain or clone an e‑key credential.

T3.attack_vector: Deliver malicious firmware via the unauthenticated OTA update channel that reads the persistent keys through the I2C/SPI interfaces

T4.attack_vector: Exploitation of STRIDE-I-001 (Information Disclosure via Cleartext Credential Transmission) via unencrypted transmission targeting Cryptographic Keys

T5.attack_vector: Exploitation of CAPEC-100 (Overflow Buffers) via access control bypass targeting Audit Log

T6.attack_vector: Attacker extracts the hard‑coded BLE pairing key from the lock’s firmware and uses it to craft a forged unlock command over the BLE GATT interface
